ticker_news.title: Nvidia, Tesla, Goodyear rise premarket; Verizon, CrowdStrike fall By Investing.com - Investing.com Canada
ticker_news.description: U.S. stock futures rebounded after last week's losses, with Nvidia, Tesla, and Goodyear rising in premarket trading, while Verizon and CrowdStrike fell.
ticker_news.author: Peter Nurse

ticker_news.title: Nasdaq Futures Outperforms After Last Week's Swoon: What's Going On - Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (NASDAQ:QQQ), SPDR S&P 500 (ARCA:SPY) - Benzinga
ticker_news.description: U.S. stocks are expected to rebound this week, driven by strong earnings expectations, the Federal Reserve's rate cut, and the rising odds of a victory for former President Donald Trump in the upcoming election. Bargain hunting in beaten-down stocks could also lend support.
ticker_news.author: Shanthi Rexaline

ticker_news.title: Musk says Tesla will have humanoid robots for internal use in 2025 - Investing.com
ticker_news.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that the company plans to introduce humanoid robots, known as Optimus, for internal use in 2025 and potentially for external customers by 2026.
ticker_news.author: Sam Bougheddaa

ticker_news.title: RBC Capital sees Elon Musk's robotaxi plans reshaping Tesla stock narrative - Investing.com
ticker_news.description: RBC Capital maintained its Outperform rating on Tesla stock, noting that the anticipation surrounding Tesla's upcoming robotaxi event could be driving recent stock performance and potentially reshaping the company's narrative.
ticker_news.author: Emilio Ghigini

ticker_news.title: Ford (F) Q2 Earnings Preview: Time to Buy the Stock Now? - Zacks Investment Research
ticker_news.description: Ford is set to release its Q2 2024 results on July 24. The company's earnings and revenue are expected to decline year-over-year, but its electric vehicle sales have been strong, with Ford being the second-largest EV brand in the US. The company's growth prospects are driven by its popular vehicle lineup and robust EV offerings, though its electric vehicle unit is expected to post losses this year.
ticker_news.author: Zacks Investment Research
